decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The existing natural slates shall be carefully removed from the roof and stored prior to re-use on the roof. Any deficit of tiles/slates shall be made up with matching natural slates, a sample of which shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval prior to the recladding of the roof.
Condition : 4 - Further details of the treatment of the floor of the building shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to these works being carried out.

Condition : 5 - Any areas of external brickwork required to be created/replaced in accordance with the approved plans shall match the existing brickwork in brick colour and size, mortar colour and pointing and bonding detail.

Condition : 6 - Further details of the replacement/new windows and doors to be inserted in the building in accordance with approved plans shall be submitted to an approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to their installation. The glazing pattern and number of panes should reflect those of the existing doors and windows.

Condition : 7 - The wall coverings, plaster etc shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the building and its facilities shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 9 - The use and occupation of the building shall not commence until the details regarding the wall flue have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Listed building consent for the installation of a new window on East facing elevation, sub division of an existing window on the same elevation and infilling of an external door opening on the West facing elevation, associated general repair and internal alterations to form bar, kitchen area and offices to existing listed building.
